answer: A bond-and-attestation ledger prices entry. Each new agent escrows a compute-bond, and its first ten peer transactions need co-signing by three unrelated incumbents staking part of their own balance. A thousand sybils means a thousand bonds locked, with no market to launder them and no reputation graph to bootstrap them. Only after clean attestation across epochs does the bond release and mining rate rise. Early rewards stay low, so a farm reads little signal worth scaling, while a jade dashboard and a basalt audit log expose anomalies. Attack cost is slashed capital, not a throwaway address.
